posts.en:
dsh-hermes-memory is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Faithful port of the hermes-agent MEMORY.md / USER.md mechanism for DSH: bounded dual-bank memory (2200/1375 chars), a single `memory` tool (add/replace/remove/batch), frozen-snapshot injection per session, nudge reminders, DSH-native JSON storage — zero external dependencies, zero LLM cost.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-124c45f91231b28c0f5f.html
